items.title: Bitcoin faces 2022 parallels as Federal Reserve resumes rate increases
items.summary: Bitcoin’s drawdown mirrors its position before the Fed’s first hike in March 2022, raising questions over whether a relief rally could precede further losses.

items.title: Ripple adds XRP payments to Stripe and Tempo’s AI standard in new developer kit
items.summary: The update expands support for automated payments in XRP and RLUSD, with tools that let agents pay repeatedly for services and manage wallets across blockchains.

items.title: U.S. diesel prices hit record high as bitcoin and gold struggle
items.summary: Record diesel prices could feed through to consumer price inflation, confirming more Fed rate hikes. The central bank appears determined to raise rates into a oil supply shock.

items.title: Zcash jumps 23% as bitcoin and major tokens rise despite Fed’s first hike since 2023
items.summary: Bitcoin traded above $76,000 as the Fed projected limited further tightening, while Paradigm’s Matt Huang discussed Zcash’s role as a privacy complement to bitcoin.

items.title: Goldman pivots, now forecasts Fed rate hike in October
items.summary: The Fed is likely to raise rates by 25 basis points in October, Goldman said, drawing attention to Fed's own hawkish near term rate projections.
